content.text: {"vat": "A boxy, enclosed motor car (early-1900s style) standing in the street behind a woman and a horse", "dac_diem": "Square, upright cabin with a flat white-topped roof. Two small windows at the front or rear. Dark body. It looks like a Model T-era automobile. A horse and several people in long dresses and caps stand around it. Tall brick buildings line the street.", "co_tu_nam": 1908, "da_co_nam_1667": "no", "ly_do": "The enclosed, box-bodied automobile appears to be an early-20th-century design (Model T era, about 1908–1920s). Motor cars did not exist in 1667, so it is an anachronism. Horse-drawn coaches were the only vehicles of that kind then."}
